notes.title: SAKeRETSU “Recipes” free DLC now live! (1.36) [Minor spoilers]
notes.content:
Our second free DLC for SAKeRETSU is now live! This update comes with 7 new items that can be obtained through the new recipe mechanic in the shop. (But you will have to figure out how to produce them!)

Large Monster Dung: Extended stealth from monsters
Giant Monster Dung: Prolonged stealth from monsters
Skull and Bones: Massive damage with a lasting effect
Barbed Harpoon: Chance to steal and poison enemy
Bag of Ashes: Massive blow will leave enemy blinded
Arsenic urn: Leaves enemy blinded and poisoned
Black diamond: The ultimate weapon of Mu

We hope you all enjoy these new items and we look forward to your feedback!  

Christopher Klassen, Klassen Games

notes.title: SAKeRETSU “Nightmare” free DLC now live! (1.32)
notes.content:
Our first free DLC for SAKeRETSU is now live! This update comes with 6 new difficulty and challenge modes:

Difficulty modes:

Standard: Standard enemies
For first time undead.

 Hard: Hard enemies
For experienced undead seeking a challenge.

Nightmare: Nightmare enemies
For adept undead seeking an intense challenge.

Challenge modes:

Scavenger: Hard enemies, player gets only 1 stat point per level
For reckless undead seeking an unbeatable challenge.

Isolation: Hard enemies, no shop or monster allies
For lonely undead seeking a hopeless challenge.

Moot: Hard enemies, player hurts self upon fighting, death upon fleeing battle
For manic undead seeking prolonged torture.

Tortured: Nightmare enemies, player stats reset upon death
For mad undead seeking a second death.

We hope you all enjoy these new game modes and we look forward to your feedback!  

Christopher Klassen, Klassen Games
